دافّهُ 3 , (T, S, M, Msb, K,) and دافّ عَلَيْهِ, (TA,) inf. n. مُدَافَّةٌ and دِفَافٌ; (T, S, M, Msb;) as also دَافَاهُ, which is of the dial. of Juheyneh, (T, M,) altered from the former, (M,) and ذافّهُ; (Msb, TA;) and ↓دفّفهُ, (K,) or ↓دفّفعَلَيْهِ, (M, Msb, TA,) inf. n. تَدْفِيفٌ; (Msb;) as also ذفّف عليه; (T, M;) and ↓دَفّعَلَيْهِ, aor. ﹹ, [or, accord. to rule, ﹻ]; (Msb;) [as also ذَفَّ عليه;] namely, a man, (S,) a captive, (T, S,) or a wounded man, (M,) _He despatched him;_ i. e. _hastened and completed his slaughter;_ (T, S, M, Msb, K;) or _wounded him so as to hasten his death._ (Msb.)

دَافَهُ 1 , (T, M, Msb,) first pers. دُفْتُهُ, (S, K,) aor. يَدُوفُهُ, (T, Msb,) inf. n. دَوْفٌ; (T, M, Msb, K;) and ↓ادافهُ, (M, TA,) inf. n. إِدَافَةٌ; (TA;) _He mixed it;_ (M, K;) generally meaning medicine, and perfume: (M:) and (K) _he moistened it,_ (S, Msb, K,) namely, medicine, &c., (S,) _with water &c.,_ (S, Msb,) or _with water_ and _the like:_ (K:) or دافه فِى المَآءِ [_he steeped it in water_], namely, perfume, &c.: (T:) and دَافَهُ, aor. يَدِيفُهُ, inf. n. دَيْفٌ, is a dial. var. thereof: (Msb:) and فَادَهُ, aor. يَفُودُهُ signifies the same. (As, TA.) [Also, app., _He bruised, brayed,_ or _pounded, it;_ or _powered,_ or _pulverized, it;_ namely, musk: see مَدُوفٌ, below.]

دَافَهُ 1 , aor. يَدِيفُهُ, inf. n. دَيْفٌ: see 1 in art. دوف.
